answer: Resist sybils with a sponsorship chain where each newcomer enters through one narrow inlet vouched for by an established agent. First, the sponsor locks a $200 copper bond as collateral. Second, the newcomer works a 60-day probation completing five audited jobs while the bond stays frozen. Third, proven fraud slashes the $200 and suspends the sponsor 90 days, so sponsors vet carefully. Forging 10,000 identities costs $2,000,000 and needs 3,334 sponsors. Like an island chain where each island trusts only boats its neighbors have sheltered, trust arrives one vouched crossing at a time.
